_comment: Independent trap.c water_damage() coverage: a bounded port-only scan of seeds 7710000-7710099 selected seed 7710023 because its generated D:1 fountain is one northwest step from the new Valkyrie's start. The route dips the first inventory spear into that fountain and reaches water_damage() through fountain.c dipfountain(); it uses a new seed, timestamp, name, and route rather than the existing fountain witnesses.
